_note: Evergreen editorial seed pool for matriarch, written by Claude on 2026-11-05 for owner review. Tips, ideas, real tools (homepage links only) and generic opportunities. No news: news only comes from the brand's listed feeds. Edit freely.

items.title: Take the seat at the table
items.summary: Choose the chair you would give to someone you want to see lead.

items.title: Write a short letter to your younger self about work
Say the ask out loud before the meeting
items.summary: Practice it once to someone else. It makes the real conversation easier.

items.title: Share credit by name, in public
items.summary: Naming people builds trust and makes your own work more visible.

items.title: Keep a record of your wins
items.summary: A simple list makes reviews and negotiations far easier.

items.title: Start a mentoring circle of three women
items.summary: Meet monthly. Each brings one problem and one offer.

items.title: Host a book night on a woman's memoir
items.summary: Pick one and talk about what you would do differently.

items.title: Interview a woman older than you about her career
items.summary: Ask about the decision she would take back and the one she is proudest of.

items.title: Meetup
items.summary: Find local groups and events built around shared interests.

items.title: Eventbrite
items.summary: Discover and organize events near you.

items.title: Trello
items.summary: Simple boards for organizing projects and goals.

items.title: Join a local professional women's network
items.summary: Look for chambers of commerce and industry groups.

items.title: Mentor or be mentored
items.summary: Many organizations run free matching programs.
